```{r}
#| include: false
root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("renv.lock"))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
for (f in setdiff(list.files(file.path(root, "R"), pattern = "[.]R$"), "_dependencies.R")) source(file.path(root, "R", f))
source(file.path(root, "studies", "301", "tlf", "tlf_common.R"))
d <- targets::tar_read(csr_301_data, store = file.path(root, "_targets"))
p <- d$protocol
s <- d$sap
b <- csr_blinding(d$unblinded)
lock <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path(root, "docs", "lock", "dblock-301.yml"))
item <- function(items, id) purrr::keep(items, function(x) x$id == id)[[1]]
asis <- function(x) cat(x, sep = "\n")
table_md <- function(id) asis(csr_table(d$tables[[id]]))
figure_md <- function(id) asis(csr_figure(id, d$files, root))
title_of <- function(id) item(d$outputs$outputs, id)$title
adsl <- d$adsl
n_rand <- sum(adsl$RANDFL == "Y")
n_saf <- sum(adsl$SAFFL == "Y")
n_pps <- sum(adsl$PPROTFL %in% "Y")
n_comp <- sum(adsl$EOTSTT %in% "COMPLETED")
n_disc_study <- sum(adsl$EOSSTT %in% "DISCONTINUED")
pct <- function(n, N) sprintf("%d (%s%%)", n, formatC(100 * n / N, format = "f", digits = 1))
eff <- d$analysis$efficacy$results
sec <- d$analysis$secondary$results
mult <- d$analysis$multiplicity
est <- function(r, digits = 2) sprintf("%s (95%% CI %s to %s)", fmt_num(r$estimate, digits), fmt_num(r$lower, digits), fmt_num(r$upper, digits))
```

::: {.callout-note}
**Simulated data · fictional compound.** FJF-2026 does not exist. Every number in this report is
generated by code from a sealed data-generating model. The structure follows ICH E3; the
tables and figures are those of the pipeline (`docs/sap/fjf-2026-301-outputs.yml`), embedded
unchanged.
:::

# Synopsis

| | |
|---|---|
| Study | `r p$study`, phase `r p$phase` |
| Title | `r p$title` |
| Design | Randomised `r paste(unlist(p$randomisation$ratio), collapse = ":")`, stratified by `r p$randomisation$stratification[[1]]$factor`. `r p$randomisation$blinding` |
| Treatments | `r paste(purrr::map_chr(p$arms, "label"), collapse = "; ")` |
| Duration | `r p$treatment_weeks` weeks of treatment, `r p$follow_up_weeks` weeks of follow-up |
| Patients | `r n_rand` randomised (planned `r 2 * d$sample_size`), `r n_saf` treated |
| Primary endpoint | Change from baseline in HbA1c at week `r p$primary_visit_week` (treatment-policy estimand E1) |
| Database lock | `r substr(lock$locked_at, 1, 10)` (tag `dblock-301`, frozen commit `r substr(lock$frozen_commit, 1, 7)`) |
| Status | `r if (b$blinded) "**Blinded**: results by arm use dummy arms" else "Unblinded"` |

# Ethics

The study is simulated: there are no patients, investigators or ethics committees. The
protocol's ethical content (consent, eligibility, rescue, the duty to keep following patients
who stop treatment) is written as for a real study and reviewed in the protocol synopsis.

# Introduction

FJF-2026 is a fictional once-daily oral glucose-lowering drug, studied here added to metformin.
`r trimws(p$dose_rationale)`

# Study objectives and estimands

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (e in d$estimands$estimands) {
  asis(c(
    sprintf("## %s: %s (%s)", e$id, e$label, e$role), "",
    sprintf("*%s*", trimws(e$question)), "",
    sprintf("- **Population:** %s", e$population),
    sprintf("- **Treatment:** %s", trimws(e$treatment)),
    sprintf("- **Variable:** %s", e$variable),
    vapply(e$intercurrent_events, function(i) {
      sprintf("- **%s:** %s strategy. %s", tools::toTitleCase(i$event), i$strategy, trimws(i$rationale))
    }, ""),
    sprintf("- **Summary measure:** %s", e$summary), ""
  ))
}
```

# Investigational plan

## Design

```{r}
#| results: asis
v <- p$visits
visits <- data.frame(Visit = v$code, Label = v$label, Week = v$week, Window = sprintf("±%d days", v$window_days))
asis(csr_markdown(visits))
```

## Selection of patients

Adults aged `r p$eligibility$age_years[1]` to `r p$eligibility$age_years[2]` years with type 2
diabetes and HbA1c `r fmt_num(p$eligibility$hba1c_screening_pct[1], 1)`% to
`r fmt_num(p$eligibility$hba1c_screening_pct[2], 1)`% on stable metformin.

```{r}
#| results: asis
asis(c("**Inclusion criteria**", "", paste("-", unlist(p$eligibility$inclusion)), ""))
asis(c("**Exclusion criteria**", "", paste("-", unlist(p$eligibility$exclusion)), ""))
```

## Treatments, randomisation and blinding

Patients were randomised `r paste(unlist(p$randomisation$ratio), collapse = ":")` within
strata of `r p$randomisation$stratification[[1]]$factor`
(`r paste(unlist(p$randomisation$stratification[[1]]$levels), collapse = ", ")`).
`r p$randomisation$blinding`.

**Rescue medication.** `r trimws(p$rescue$medication)` Rescue was triggered by fasting plasma
glucose above `r paste(purrr::map_chr(p$rescue$thresholds, function(t) sprintf("%d mg/dL (weeks %d to %d)", t$fpg_mg_dl, t$from_week, t$to_week)), collapse = ", ")`.
`r p$rescue$confirmation`. `r p$rescue$after_rescue`

**Discontinuation.** `r trimws(p$discontinuation$rule)`

**Blinding of the analysis.** Until the database lock, and after it until the reviewer
authorises the unblinding, the pipeline uses a dummy assignment: the real arms shuffled within
each stratum with a public seed (ADR 0027, ADR 0032). SDTM, ADaM, the analyses and every output
were programmed and checked on the dummy arms.

## Sample size

`r d$sample_size` patients per arm. In the dry run of the SAP (`r d$oc$trials[1]` simulated
trials on planning values), the primary analysis had power
`r formatC(100 * d$oc$power[1], format = "f", digits = 1)`% (Monte Carlo SE
`r formatC(100 * d$oc$mcse[1], format = "f", digits = 1)`%).

# Data management and quality

## From the raw data to the outputs

The raw (EDC-like) data are loaded once into PostgreSQL with an audit trail, checked against
`docs/specs/raw-layer.yml`, cleaned by the rules of `docs/specs/cleaning-rules.yml`, mapped to
SDTM (SDTMIG 3.4) and derived to ADaM (ADaMIG 1.3) by the programs of `studies/301`. Each step
is a target of one reproducible pipeline (R 4.6.1 in Docker, packages pinned by renv).

```{r}
#| results: asis
q <- d$raw_quality
found <- q[q$n > 0, ]
asis(c(
  sprintf(
    "The raw-data quality checks ran %d checks; %d found records, handled as the cleaning rules say:",
    nrow(q), nrow(found)
  ), ""
))
if (nrow(found) > 0) {
  asis(csr_markdown(data.frame(Check = found$check, Table = found$table, Records = found$n, Detail = found$detail)))
}
```

## Second programming

Every SDTM domain, ADaM dataset and table cell was programmed a second time, independently
(`qc/301`), and compared with production.

```{r}
#| results: asis
qc <- d$qc
qc$clean <- ifelse(qc$clean, "Agree", "**Differ**")
asis(csr_markdown(qc, c("Level", "Units", "Compared", "Result")))
```

## CDISC conformance

Pinnacle 21 Community and CDISC CORE were run on the SDTM and ADaM packages; every finding is
explained in `studies/301/conformance.md` and in the reviewer's guides (`studies/301/csdrg.qmd`,
`studies/301/adrg.qmd`).

## Database lock

The database was locked on `r substr(lock$locked_at, 1, 10)` by `r lock$locked_by`, after the
second programmings agreed (`tools/lock-database.sh`). Programs, specifications and cleaning
rules are frozen at commit `r substr(lock$frozen_commit, 1, 7)` (tag `dblock-301`). Decisions
taken before the lock: `r paste(unlist(lock$decisions), collapse = ", ")`.

## Primary endpoint

In the primary analysis (A1, treatment-policy estimand E1, jump to reference), the difference
FJF-2026 minus placebo in the change of HbA1c at week `r p$primary_visit_week` was
`r est(eff[eff$analysis == "A1", ])` percentage points, p = `r p_301(eff$p_value[eff$analysis == "A1"])`.
The hypothesis H1 was `r if (mult$rejected[mult$hypothesis == "H1"]) "rejected" else "not rejected"`.

```{r}
#| results: asis
table_md("T-14.2.1")
table_md("T-14.2.2")
```

## Sensitivity analyses

```{r}
asis(c(sprintf("- %s: %s", r$analysis, vapply(seq_len(nrow(r)), function(i) est(r[i, ]), "")), ""))
asis(c(sprintf("Tipping point (S3): %s percentage points.", fmt_num(d$analysis$efficacy$tipping_point, 2)), ""))
table_md("T-14.2.3")
figure_md("F-14.2.1")
figure_md("F-14.2.2")
```
